title: Software engineering short-answer assessment with LLM grading
summary: Students answer short-response questions in software engineering courses. Large language models compare responses against assessment criteria or reference material to produce grades, and the study evaluates those grades against human judgments rather than exposing the model to students during the task.

sources.title: Automatic Grading of Short Answers Using Large Language Models in Software Engineering Courses

assessment.summary: Write short answers to software engineering questions for automated LLM-supported grading.

student_role.description: LLMs grade responses after submission; AI use while answering is not reported.

assessment_system_role: Assign grades to short answers from criteria or reference answers.

grading.method: LLM-generated grades are compared with human grading.

human_validation.description: Researchers compare model grades against human judgments.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
